description: Non material amendment to allow use class D2 (leisure) to the list of allowable use classes for commercial unit 11 and associated amendments to planning conditions 2, 46 and 58 of planning permission 00616/F/P23 dated 17/04/2020 for Application under Section 73 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended) for a variation of Condition 2 (approved drawings); Condition 57 (Dwellings number) and 58 (Commercial Floorspace) of planning permission 00616/F/P21 to substitute the approved drawings to allow a decrease in the retail A1-A5 floor area from 11,199 sqm to 8,897 sqm (Gross External Area), introduction of 1,214 sqm (Gross External Area) B1(a) office floor space to replace retail mezzanine in units 3, 4 and 5 (Block E), 60 additional homes (11 homes through conversion of retail mezzanines in units 10 and 11 in Blocks B and C; 49 homes within additional storeys above Blocks A, B [except Tower] and C) to increase total number of residential homes to 588, and alterations to the fenestration, elevational detailing, massing, amenity space and cycle parking provision for development comprising:  Demolition of commercial and residential properties, site  clearance and redevelopment comprising the construction of a mixed-use development comprising private and affordable residential units, a multiscreen cinema, commercial floorspace, infrastructure including parking spaces, cycle parking spaces, service areas, public realm incorporating pedestrian/cycle circulation areas with associated hard and soft landscaping and private amenity spaces.
